  • Method Details

    • findMatchingClass

      public static Optional<org.codehaus.groovy.ast.ClassNode> findMatchingClass(org.codehaus.groovy.ast.ClassNode node, Predicate<org.codehaus.groovy.ast.ClassNode> predicate)
      Finds the first class in the hierarchy of the given node that matches the given predicate. This is a breadth-first search, with superclasses being visited before interfaces.
      Parameters:
      node - the node to start the search from
      predicate - the predicate to match
      Returns:
      the first class in the hierarchy that matches the predicate

    • findClassSearchResult

      public static <T> Optional<T> findClassSearchResult(org.codehaus.groovy.ast.ClassNode node, Function<org.codehaus.groovy.ast.ClassNode,T> converter)
      Finds the first non-null conversion result in the hierarchy of the given classnode. This is a breadth-first search, with superclasses being visited before interfaces.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the conversion result
      Parameters:
      node - the node to start the search from
      converter - the converter to apply to each class node
      Returns:
      the first non-null conversion result in the hierarchy

    • getMethodHierarchy

      public static Stream<org.codehaus.groovy.ast.MethodNode> getMethodHierarchy(org.codehaus.groovy.ast.MethodNode node)
      Returns the full hierarchy of the given method node, starting with the method itself. I.e. this returns the method as well as all methods that this method overrides or implements. This is a breadth-first search, with superclasses being visited before interfaces.
      Parameters:
      node - the node to start the search from
      Returns:
      the full hierarchy of the method node

    • getSuperMethods

      public static Stream<org.codehaus.groovy.ast.MethodNode> getSuperMethods(org.codehaus.groovy.ast.MethodNode node)
      Returns the full hierarchy of the given method node, excluding the method itself. I.e. this return all methods that this method overrides or implements. This is a breadth-first search, with superclasses being visited before interfaces.
      Parameters:
      node - the node to start the search from
      Returns:
      the full hierarchy of the method node
